Container.Name: tailarr
Container.Overview:
Tailarr changes what's inside your MKV files (tracks, default/forced flags, track names, Dolby Vision) without ever re-encoding. A friendly web front-end for MKVToolNix and dovi_tool, made to sit alongside Radarr, Sonarr and Plex.
Map /data exactly the same way as in Radarr and Sonarr (TRaSH Guides layout), so file paths match.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: The port for Tailarr's web page.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Your data share, mapped exactly like in Radarr and Sonarr (TRaSH Guides: /mnt/user/data to /data). Tailarr only works inside the Films and TV folders you choose in its Settings.

Config.Name: Films folder
Config.Description: Starting value for the Films folder, as seen inside the container. Can be changed later in Settings.

Config.Name: TV folder
Config.Description: Starting value for the TV folder, as seen inside the container. Can be changed later in Settings.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns files Tailarr creates. Unraid's default is 99 (nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns files Tailarr creates. Unraid's default is 100 (users).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: File permissions mask. 002 lets your other containers and shares change Tailarr's files.
